theory.heading: What Model Drift Monitoring is
theory.body: Model Drift Monitoring describes the methods and patterns used within AI Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Model Drift Monitoring is a named, repeatable concept.

It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Model Drift Monitoring matters
theory.body: Without Model Drift Monitoring, systems built with AI Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Model Drift Monitoring works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Model Drift Monitoring follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Model Drift Monitoring.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Model Drift Monitoring
theory.body: Model Drift Monitoring offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
